messages:
amanda: Quick idea — add a "bulk defaults" flow to Console so teams can set org/service-level default runtime flags with a safe preflight + telemetry gate.
lee: Sounds useful. main worry = blast radius. need a strict dry-run + preview before any write. :eyes:
samir: Agreed. Also want percent sampling and tenant-hash targeting so we can roll gradually.
jess: What safety signals do we gate on? latency / errors / token-cost?
amanda: Planning: UI bulk editor -> preflight simulation (sample %) -> telemetry diff (baseline vs simulated) -> canary apply -> ramp. Add operator lock and auto-pause on threshold.
console-ux: I can mock screens: preview of affected services/routes, sample slider, expected delta preview, and an actions timeline.
lee: Preflight needs to return affected count + metric deltas. Also show top-5 affected tenants by traffic.
amanda: Example API prototype: 
```
POST /api/v1/configs/bulk-defaults/preflight
Payload: {
  "scope": "org",
  "selector": {"service": "*"},
  "changes": {"prefix_cache_ttl_ms": 3000},
  "sample_pct": 5,
  "exclude_tenants": ["tenant-prod-1"]
}
```
Response: { "affected": 432, "simulated_delta": { "p95_latency_ms": 1.2, "5xx_rate_pct": 0.02 } }

jess: Keep units explicit (ms, percentage). Also include tokens-per-request delta (avg_tokens) so cost impact is visible.
samir: Add safety thresholds defaults: auto-pause if 5xx increase > 0.5pct OR p95 +50ms OR avg_tokens +10%. These should be configurable per org.
lee: We should support hash-based cohorting: sample by sha256(tenant_id) mod 100 < sample_pct. That keeps it stable across runs.
ops-bot: preflight queued: job id preflight-1790012345. Track with `/preflight status preflight-1790012345`.
amanda: Perf note — accurate simulation needs running inference on historical traces; heavy. Idea: two-stage preflight: 1) cheap estimator over aggregated metrics, 2) full sampled-trace replay for chosen sample sizes. Show estimator + confidence intervals.
console-ux: UX idea — show estimator CI and a CTA: "Run full sample (recommended)".
samir: Rollback hooks: create a reversal config automatically and attach to the rollout so ops can one-click revert. Also emit an automatic runbook draft if threshold is exceeded.
lee: Need an operator abort API and an incident integration. If auto-pause fires, create incident draft and ping @ops.
ops-bot: hook added: on_threshold_exceed -> create_incident('bulk-default:auto-pause', source='console-bulk-defaults'), draft runbook attached.
jess: Small question: what about dependent flags? If one default changes, it may conflict with service-level overrides. Preflight should list override hierarchy and which tenants have explicit overrides.
amanda: Good call — preflight will show override shadowing and a count of tenants with explicit overrides so PMs can decide.
lee: Tests: add an end-to-end test that runs preflight on a synthetic dataset and asserts that thresholds and aborts work.
samir: Also telemetry: emit audit events for every candidate change, and preflight snapshot so we can replay later if needed.
console-ux: I'll add two mock screens: "Preview" and "Safety & Telemetry". Sending links later.
amanda: Next steps: 1) Samir/Lee sketch API + sampling impl, 2) Console-UX mockups, 3) Perf estimator spike, 4) Ops hook wiring. Sync Thurs 11am?
lee: +1 for Thurs.
samir: I'll take API spike.
jess: I'll draft the recommended safety thresholds and include examples.
ops-bot: preflight-1790012345 started full sample run (estimated 15m).
amanda: Thanks — we'll watch the telemetry diff and iterate. :thumbsup:
